Description
The City of Kennewick will receive proposals for RFP 26-013 "BIPIN RMS and JMS/CMS Software Replacement" until September 10, 2026 at 3:00 P.M.

The Bi-County Police Information Network (BIPIN) is seeking proposals from qualified contractors to establish a contract through competitive negotiation for a Public Safety Records and Jail Management System for the BIPIN Consortium of various law enforcement agencies in Benton and Franklin Counties, Washington.

The BIPIN Executive Committee is currently seeking to replace the current Records Management and Corrections Management (RMS/CMS/Mobile) solution implemented in April 2022 after a conversion from Intergraph I/Leads to Tyler Public Safety. Qualified Contractors with a history of successfully delivering a proven, turnkey public safety records and jail management systems for all the BIPIN partners are encouraged to respond. The expectation is that the Contractor will furnish, provide, deliver, install, configure, implement (including multiple sources of data migration), service, and maintain a multijurisdictional System as described in the RFP.

A pre-proposal meeting was held through Microsoft Teams on July 27, 2026 at 11:00 A.M. Information and invitations was sent out to prospective contractors who emailed the main proposal point of contact for the City with the subject line: RFP 26-013 BIPIN Software Replacement Conference Meeting.

The City will post any addenda and bidder questions & answers solely through Public Purchase. The City cannot guarantee receipt of all bidder documentation to outside third-party centers.

Contact Public Purchase directly if unable to access documents online at support@publicpurchase.com. Online chat is available from 7:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. MT at www.publicpurchase.com top left corner.

The City of Kennewick reserves the right to waive any informalities or to reject any or all bids.

For proposal submission, questions or additional information, please use the following contact:

Pat Buyer
IT Manager
Email: purchasing@agency.example
Phone: 555-010-0199

Delivery Information

Bids due no later than: September 10, 2026 at 3:00 P.M. (Pacific Time).

The preferred submission method for bids is electronic submission via email to purchasing@agency.example with a subject line that includes the words, “Response to RFP 26-013 BIPIN RMS and JMS/CMS Software Replacement”. Bids may be hand delivered to: City of Kennewick Purchasing Department, Finance Door A, Attn: Pat Buyer, 210 W 6th Ave. Kennewick, WA 99336. All transmittals must reference “Response to RFP 26-013 BIPIN RMS and JMS/CMS Software Replacement".

Questions shall be accepted until August 20, 2026, 11:00 A.M. (Pacific Time). Questions received after this deadline may go unanswered. Please note there are three rounds of questions as well as a pre-proposal meeting. Responses will be posted to Public Purchase shortly after the due date.
